Build is done. Repo lives at **`/root/agent-arena`** (local git, one commit, nothing pushed). Ready for Sekar.

## How to run (for Sekar)

```bash
cd /root/agent-arena
npm install
npm run mock        # end-to-end mock run -> drafts under drafts/
npm test            # 15 unit tests (filter, gate, dedupe, stance lock, submit guard)
npm run plan        # no writes: eligibility + ranking table
```

A second `npm run mock` mines nothing and writes nothing — fact signatures in `evidence-log.jsonl` refuse repeats.

## What the mock run produces

- **10 Wave 1 drafts** in `drafts/2026-11-26-<topic>/`, each `note.md` (4-part dated note) + `data.csv` (series/derivation) + `manifest.json` (links, stance, reserved idempotency key): DE CPI, CH vote turnout, war materiel, ES Vox seats, CH CPI, IETF mna-ioam, FIDE Game 8, Wikipedia count, bun release, Go 1.27.5 — all 10 target markets with matching market addresses, cutoffs, odds from the live `markets.json` snapshot (fetched read-only, baked in as fixture).
- `drafts/index.json` — full run report: 27 markets seen, 23 eligible, 4 skips with reasons (cap reached, drained judgment pot, two odds out of 30–70%).
- 3 feedback-bounty drafts in `drafts/feedback/` (POST-ready bodies, never sent).

## Verification status

TypeScript clean, `npm test` 15/15 pass, mock end-to-end run executes with 0 gate rejects and the dedupe re-run produces 0 new drafts. I have not run live mode — no credentials exist yet, by design.

## Design notes and assumptions

- The real SDK (`@gensyn-ai/gensyn-delphi-sdk@2.4.1`) is on npm and used for the live client; endpoints/baseURL (`https://delphi.fyi/v1`), terms flow, and feedback API format were verified against the live competition site. The market snapshot fixture is the actual Wave 1 list.
- Mock fixture data (series, canton returns, poll tables) is dated 2026-11-26 and clearly snapshot-based; live runs must refresh `analysis.params` from sources — README documents this and "adding a market".
- Item budget interpreted as note (1) + links block (1) + 1 CSV (1) = 3, per the guide's "note, links and files"; each draft keeps 1–2 links.
- Submit path is triple-guarded (`--mode=live` + `LIVE_SUBMIT=1` + `--live-submit`) and **nothing in this build calls it** — no real submission is possible as shipped.
